prior_observer_gate.scope: One triplet only. The same request IDs are compared in the two cleans. Requests are exposed when their observed P/D query starts inside the actual profile ROI. This local check prevents a whole-trace average from hiding exposure effects. It is not a causal confidence interval.

ROI.scope: Actual collector enable/disable anchors. A deferred ROI synchronizes its left boundary. Kernel union and gaps must be clipped to these GPU-clock anchors. Observer overhead is checked on the full clean/profile/clean serving trace.

P.scope: Kernel-name classification on actual CUDA activity. Unknown kernels remain UNKNOWN. Attention metadata is not the attention forward kernel. Fused Norm/residual is not divided. Union durations avoid double counting. Cross-category overlaps are separate. Projection subtypes cannot be recovered from a shared GEMM name. No GPU operator-to-request allocation is assumed.
